📖 How to use

  2. Enter your goal finish time.
  3. Read the required pace per km, per mile and your average speed.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a realistic marathon goal for a beginner?

Most first-timers aim to finish strong around 4:30–5:30, which is roughly 6:24–7:50 per km. Train at goal pace in long runs.

Should I run even splits?

Even pacing (same pace every km) is the most efficient strategy for most runners. This tool gives you that even-split target.

How do I convert pace to speed?

Speed (km/h) = 60 ÷ pace in min/km. A 6:00/km pace is 10 km/h.
